FAQ

Questions before the project starts.

What affects the final website cost?+

The final price depends on the number of pages, content support, integrations, migration work, and post-launch requirements. We confirm the scope and quote before work begins.

How long does a website project usually take?+

A simple website can be built in as little as 7 days once the scope, content, and access are ready. More complex websites take longer; the confirmed schedule depends on pages, integrations, content readiness, feedback timing, and the approved scope.

Will the website work on phones and tablets?+

Responsive design and front-end development are part of the core service contract. The agreed routes and conversion paths are tested at relevant breakpoints before handoff.

Can you connect forms or online booking?+

Yes, when included in the agreed scope. We confirm the endpoint, validation, notification, privacy, and staging behavior before launch.

Is SEO included?+

Basic SEO is included with every website: clear page structure, metadata, indexability foundations, and technical setup. More advanced SEO—research, content, audits, and ongoing implementation—is a separate service.

What do you need from me to get started?+

If you already have a logo, brand colours, images, or videos, bring them with your offer and access. If you do not have those assets yet, that is not a problem; we identify what is needed and agree how to handle it before build work starts.
